Description

Ctrl/Status register to Enable EAP after EAP programming is complete, and read the current node.

Contents

Bits Identifier Access Reset Decoded Name
[63:16] - - - -
[15] DisableLocalClockHalt rw 0x0 -
[14] DisableGlobalClockHalt rw 0x0 -
[13:7] ClaChainLoopDelay rw 0x36 -
[6] EnableCla rw 0x0 -

Field Descriptions

DisableLocalClockHalt

If this bit is set, clock halt action is not applied to local clocks

DisableGlobalClockHalt

If this bit is set, clock halt action is not applied to global clocks

ClaChainLoopDelay

Creates a window in which we don’t forward the incoming Xtrigger and Clock_Halt signal

EnableCla

Set this bit to 1 to enable CLA. If this bit is set, CLA is clock gated (save pwr)

EnableEap

Set Enable EAP to 1 after EAP programming is complete

CurrentNode

Read the current node.
